title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Sabrina Patel
description: Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 policy enforcement for KMS-backed key residency and ensure every cross-region KMS decision is auditable. This PR implements enforcement knobs for KMS region pinning at policy-evaluation time, upgrades audit logging to include KMS key metadata and region decisions, and provides a migration path for existing RBAC v2 policies with advisory alerts. Changes are conservative by default (opt-in enforcement) and include a staged rollout plan (canary -> global) and a mitigation path to revert to audit-only mode. Checklist: [x] implement KMS region resolver and enforcement hook; [x] enrich audit events with kms_key_id, kms_region, policy_decision_reason; [x] add feature flag 'rbac.v2.kms_enforce_region_pinning' (off by default); [x] migration utility to annotate policies with residency hints; [x] unit + integration tests; [x] e2e canary run in staging; [x] docs and release notes. Backwards compatibility: enforcement is behind feature flag; systems relying on legacy behavior can stay in audit-only mode while teams opt-in. Rollout: enable audit logging immediately; enable enforcement for 5% of traffic in staging for 48h; then 20% in prod for 72h; full rollout gated on no regressions. Related work: ENG-2142, SEC-78, COM-19. Linear link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2142/ enforce-kms-region-pinning. Implementation notes: the policy evaluator now calls pkg/kms/resolver.NoteResolveRegion() which resolves key->region via KMS metadata and customer KMS residency policies. If feature flag disabled, evaluator only emits an audit event with decision_reason set to "region-pin-advisory". Audit schema bumped: audit.event_type, audit.kms_key_id, audit.kms_region, audit.policy_id, audit.decision, audit.decision_reason. DB migration: a lightweight migration adds audit_event->metadata JSON column (backfill script included). Testing: added unit tests for resolver failure modes, integration tests exercising cross-region key use, and a canary in perf-canary repo. CI: flaky subscription tests retried once in CI job. Security review: approved by reviewers; secrets handling unchanged (KMS IDs are recorded but never log plaintext keys). Merge method: squash.

review_threads: Marcus Lee: We should avoid adding latency to the fast-path policy evaluation. Can the resolver be cached per-request and be read-only?
Sabrina Patel: Yes, resolver result is cached in-request and we only call KMS metadata API if cache miss; added per-request cache implementation.
Priya Nambiar: Are we leaking KMS identifiers into logs? We should ensure PII/secret hygiene.
Sabrina Patel: Audit events include KMS key IDs and regions but never include key material. Team verified logs are scrubbed of credentials; added unit test to assert no plaintext secrets are logged.
Diego Ramos: Suggest adding telemetry counters for enforcement vs audit-only hits so we can track rollout impact.
Sabrina Patel: Added metrics rbk.rbac.kms.enforce_count and rbk.rbac.kms.audit_count; documented their dashboards in the runbook.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover resolver success/failure, policy annotation migration, and audit schema; integration tests exercise cross-region key usage; staging canary ran for 48h with no rejects; perf impact <1% p95 latency increase when enforcement enabled for 5% traffic.
release_notes: Security: RBAC v2: add KMS region pinning enforcement behind feature flag

notes_for_ops: Enable audit logging immediately. To opt into enforcement, flip feature flag in configmap and monitor rbk.rbac.kms.enforce_count and audit_count metrics. Backout: set feature flag to false to revert to audit-only behavior. Backfill: run migrations/2026-02-15-backfill-audit-metadata.sh in maintenance window to populate metadata for recent events.
